Exchange has no Index/BitRep dependency, so it is not a blocker for Index decoupling; no Index/ODES-authored 'observation records' are produced by Exchange itself (it embeds ODES/Replay outputs).
Peer-owned specs (Replay, ODES, Moltbot, Control Plane) were not inspected in this task; 'unwritten' is relative to this repo only.
